Aaron_1: brother of Moses (Exodus 4:14) and Levitical priest (Exodus 28:1)
Azariah_1: son [descendant] of Zadok, served as priest (1 Kings 4:2) in the temple which Solomon built (1 Chronicles 6:10)
Amaziah_1: King of Judah, son of Joash (2 Kings 12:21)
Azariah_3: [Uzziah] King of Judah, son of Amaziah (2 Kings 14:21)
Jotham_2: King of Judah, son of King Uzziah [Azariah_3] (2 Kings 15:30)
Isaiah_1: the prophet and son of Amoz (2 Kings 19:2)
Zechariah_13: 2 Chronicles 26:5, the prophet (Ezra 5:1) of the book of Zechariah, who went up with Ezra (Ezra 8:2)
Jeiel_6: the scribe who prepared Uzziah's army divisions (2 Chronicles 26:11)
Maaseiah_3: the official who prepared Uzziah's army divisions (2 Chronicles 26:11)
Hananiah_4: the king's officer over Jeiel and Maaseiah (2 Chronicles 26:11)
